quests.name: Rats in the Cellar
quests.slotAcceptText: The cellar is overrun — I'll clear it.
quests.objective: Clear the inn cellar of a giant rat and the swarm.

prompt_lines.greeting: Aldwin taps the ledger. The cellar is overrun with rats — a giant one, and a swarm in the casks. Clear them and the inn keeps a room for you.
prompt_lines.accept: Good. The hatch is off the stairs. Come back when the cellar is quiet.
prompt_lines.decline: As you will. The barrels can wait a day — not two.
prompt_lines.complete: The cellar is clear. One hundred experience for the work — I'll mark the ledger.

quests.name: Road Watch
quests.slotAcceptText: I'll escort Jory to the gate.
quests.objective: Escort Jory from the river crossing to the hamlet gate alive.

prompt_lines.greeting: Captain Ysolde Farwind nods from the gate. Jory is stranded at the river.
prompt_lines.accept: Bring Jory to this gate alive. Wolves pack the bridge.
prompt_lines.decline: Then keep the road in mind.
prompt_lines.complete: Jory is safe. The watch owes you.

spoken_lines.accept: Bring Jory to this gate alive. Wolves pack the bridge.
spoken_lines.decline: Then keep the road in mind.
spoken_lines.complete: Jory is safe. The watch owes you.

quests.name: Tamsin's Basket
quests.objective: Fetch moonpetal from the village green and deliver it.

prompt_lines.greeting: Old Tamsin clutches an empty basket. Moonpetal only opens at night on the green.
prompt_lines.accept: Fetch the moonpetal and bring it to me.
prompt_lines.complete: Bless you. Take these potions — and rest.

spoken_lines.greeting: Old Tamsin clutches an empty basket. Moonpetal only opens at night on the green.
spoken_lines.accept: Fetch the moonpetal and bring it to me.
spoken_lines.complete: Bless you. Take these potions — and rest.

quests.name: The Silent Mill
quests.objective: End Sister Maelis — dead or surrendered.

prompt_lines.greeting: Ysolde's jaw tightens. The mill is silent for the wrong reasons.
prompt_lines.accept: End Sister Maelis. Dead or kneeling — the cult stops.
prompt_lines.complete: The mill is quiet again. Well fought.

spoken_lines.greeting: Ysolde's jaw tightens. The mill is silent for the wrong reasons.
spoken_lines.accept: End Sister Maelis. Dead or kneeling — the cult stops.
spoken_lines.complete: The mill is quiet again. Well fought.

quests.name: Break the Raid
quests.objective: Stop Warcaptain Ghorza — dead or camp burned.

prompt_lines.greeting: Raid smoke on the road. Ghorza's banners.
prompt_lines.accept: Break the raid. Ghorza falls or the camp burns.
prompt_lines.decline: Then stay off the east road.
prompt_lines.complete: The road is clear. The watch drinks tonight.

spoken_lines.greeting: Raid smoke on the road. Ghorza's banners.
spoken_lines.accept: Break the raid. Ghorza falls or the camp burns.
spoken_lines.decline: Then stay off the east road.
spoken_lines.complete: The road is clear. The watch drinks tonight.

quests.name: The Lodge Fire
quests.slotAcceptText: I'll stand with you at dusk.

prompt_lines.greeting: Hesper of the Lodge regards you. Work needs doing — The Lodge Fire.
prompt_lines.accept: Defend the lodge; Hesper survives. Return when it is done.
prompt_lines.decline: Very well. The valley will wait — for a while.
prompt_lines.complete: It is done. The Lodge Fire is closed — Aldwin will see the ledger updated.

spoken_lines.greeting: Hesper of the Lodge wipes sap from a hatchet. Dusk brings spiders — and worse. Stand with me?
spoken_lines.accept: Good. Hold the porch line. When the clearing falls quiet, I walk with you.
spoken_lines.decline: Very well. The valley will wait — for a while.
spoken_lines.complete: The lodge stands. I am with you now — first companion of the valley road.

prompt_lines.greeting: Vessk hisses from the brush. Grubnash grows bold.
prompt_lines.accept: Clear the warren — or make the boss take a truce.
prompt_lines.complete: The warren is settled. Vessk pays in scrap and thanks.

spoken_lines.greeting: Vessk hisses from the brush. Grubnash grows bold.
spoken_lines.accept: Clear the warren — or make the boss take a truce.
spoken_lines.complete: The warren is settled. Vessk pays in scrap and thanks.

quests.name: Mother Ulda's Bargain
quests.objective: Recover the cult relic from the hag — fight or trade.

prompt_lines.greeting: Tamsin lowers her voice. Mother Ulda has the cult's relic.
prompt_lines.accept: Recover the relic — by steel or by bargain.
prompt_lines.complete: The relic is home. Careful with swamp debts.

spoken_lines.greeting: Tamsin lowers her voice. Mother Ulda has the cult's relic.
spoken_lines.accept: Recover the relic — by steel or by bargain.
spoken_lines.complete: The relic is home. Careful with swamp debts.

quests.name: The Ironfold Key
quests.slotAcceptText: I'll take the mine and the key.
quests.objective: Recover Durgan's ward-key in the mine, then spend it at the sealed stair in the upper tomb's crypt.

prompt_lines.greeting: Ysolde and Caddoc share a look. The mine holds Durgan's key.
prompt_lines.accept: Recover the Ironfold ward-key in the mine. Spend it in the upper tomb's crypt to open the sealed deep stair; the ward consumes its key.
prompt_lines.decline: The tomb can stay shut a little longer.
prompt_lines.complete: The ward is broken. The deep stair is open to your party. Tell Aldwin you are ready.

spoken_lines.greeting: Ysolde and Caddoc share a look. The mine holds Durgan's key.
spoken_lines.accept: Recover the Ironfold ward-key in the mine. Spend it in the upper tomb's crypt to open the sealed deep stair; the ward consumes its key.
spoken_lines.decline: The tomb can stay shut a little longer.
spoken_lines.complete: The ward is broken. The deep stair is open to your party. Tell Aldwin you are ready.

quests.name: Sun and Moon
quests.objective: Clear the shadows and relight the altar.

prompt_lines.greeting: Brother Caddoc wrings his hands. The shrine is dark.
prompt_lines.accept: Drive out the shadows and relight the altar.
prompt_lines.decline: I will pray until you can.
prompt_lines.complete: Light returns. Walk with my blessing.

spoken_lines.greeting: Brother Caddoc wrings his hands. The shrine is dark — will you cleanse it with me?
spoken_lines.accept: Bless you. Drive the shadows from the altar; I will hold the rite.
spoken_lines.decline: Very well. The valley will wait — for a while.
spoken_lines.complete: The altar burns again. Take my blessing — and my company. I heal the lowest among us first.

quests.name: Whispers in the Well
quests.slotAcceptText: I'll see what's under the well.
quests.objective: Clear the wererat nest under the hamlet well.

prompt_lines.greeting: Mira leans in. Something scratches under the well.
prompt_lines.accept: See to the nest. The square will sleep better.
prompt_lines.complete: Quiet under the stones. Drink's on the house.

spoken_lines.greeting: Mira leans in. Something scratches under the well.
spoken_lines.accept: See to the nest. The square will sleep better.
spoken_lines.complete: Quiet under the stones. Drink's on the house.

quests.name: The Pale Steward
quests.objective: End the Pale Steward under the tomb.

prompt_lines.greeting: The deep tomb is open enough to enter. What sleeps under the Warden answers to the Pale Steward. End it, and the valley may breathe again.
prompt_lines.accept: Take the crypt stair when you are ready. Caddoc will aid if he can reach you.
prompt_lines.decline: Wisely cautious. The Steward will keep.
prompt_lines.complete: The Steward is gone. Eight hundred experience — and the next chapter of the valley begins beyond level four.

Q1.greeting: Aldwin taps the ledger. The cellar is overrun with rats — a giant one, and a swarm in the casks. Clear them and the inn keeps a room for you.
Q1.accept: Good. The hatch is off the stairs. Come back when the cellar is quiet.
Q1.decline: As you will. The barrels can wait a day — not two.
Q1.complete: The cellar is clear. One hundred experience for the work — I'll mark the ledger.

Q12.greeting: The deep tomb is open enough to enter. What sleeps under the Warden answers to the Pale Steward. End it, and the valley may breathe again.
Q12.accept: Take the crypt stair when you are ready. Caddoc will aid if he can reach you.
Q12.decline: Wisely cautious. The Steward will keep.
Q12.complete: The Steward is gone. Eight hundred experience — and the next chapter of the valley begins beyond level four.

creation.welcome: Welcome. One question at a time. Which class? Any of the twelve will do. Then species, background, your name, optional appearance and backstory, and your scores — plus the class menus that follow. Confirm when the drafts are set, or discard to start over.

confirm_rejection.text: I can't set that down yet — I still need
. Tell me the rest and confirm again.

creation.ability_drafting_paths_offer: Or choose Set ability scores and fill in the six fields - and I'll read them back before you commit. Confirm the character when ready, or discard to start over.
creation.name_contract_offer: Your class choices are set. What shall I call you? Choose Name your character and enter it. I'll read it back; choose Adopt that name. Then Confirm will open so you can finish and enter the adventure.

creation.closing: It's done. Welcome to the world.

level_up.explanation: Two ways to grow, once you've earned it: 'Take the average Hit Points' for a steady, predictable gain, or 'Roll for Hit Points' on your hit die if you'd rather trust the dice. Draft either one with me, change your mind as often as you like, then tell me 'Confirm the level-up with Aldwin' once you've settled — or 'Discard the drafted choice' to start over. When the wizard names a choice menu, pick from the numbered answers.
level_up.direction: Nothing to record yet, friend. Mira behind the bar will point you at the work.
level_up.offer: You've the bearing of someone who's earned a level, friend. Come — let's talk it through.
level_up.acknowledgement: So it's done, then — you've grown stronger. Let me set your level-up down in the ledger properly.
level_up.closing: Your new training is recorded. Go well.

offer.line: You've earned a second set of eyes, friend. I know a quiet blade who will walk with you — a rogue of my trust, trained as you are. 1: Take the companion. 2: Walk alone a while longer.

accepted.line: Good. I'll send them to your side — watch their back as they watch yours.

declined.line: As you will. The offer stands if the road grows darker — but I won't press.

apply_pending.summary: Waiting for rogue companion activation receipts.

presentation.telepathic_invitation: This is Aldwin at the inn hearth. You have earned a level; come to me.
